Thank you for the support.

routing_warnings.description: The proposed segmented thermal-pad paste aperture concerns stencil and thermal-pad implementation rather than pre-reflow moisture handling.
The concrete runtime observations concern DCDC1 undervoltage and load-transient collapse; moisture damage is only one unconfirmed possible cause.
